title: Alignment Bundle Recapture on Trial Refunds — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
**Alignment bundle recapture on a Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty trial refund.** The bundle recapture is taken from the trial refund and follows the alignment plan on the vehicle under Alignment Services & Plans.

A plan is a **bundled plan** when it is active on the vehicle, was bought no more than its tire bundle window in days after the set's install date (on or after that date), at a purchase price below its plan price, so that the tire bundle discount was given.

| Bundled plan's use | Recapture |
|---|---|
| used for more than the one alignment of its purchase visit (two or more performed alignments) | its full tire bundle discount |
| used for exactly the alignment of its purchase visit | half of its tire bundle discount |
| otherwise — no bundled plan, or no alignment performed on it | nothing |

The tire bundle discount and the bundle window are those of the plan's line under Alignment Services & Plans.

**Cases (hypothetical plan with a $24.00 bundle discount, bought 10 days after installation at a reduced price):** three alignments performed — $24.00; one — $12.00; a plan bought at its full plan price — nothing.
